target.title: fix(gateway): cap pricing cache entries to prevent unbounded memory growth (#101543)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101543. The gateway model-pricing cache (`cachedPricing` Map in `model-pricing-cache-state.ts`) has no upper bound. Long-running OpenClaw processes with many dynamic models or plugins accumulate pricing entries on every 24h refresh cycle without eviction, eventually causing OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `MAX_PRICING_CACHE_ENTRIES = 1000` and caps the Map in `replaceGatewayModelPricingCache`. When a refresh produces more entries than the limit, excess entries are trimmed to keep memory bounded.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof — cache cap in action

Builds 1100 entries on main (unbounded), then demonstrates the PR branch caps at 1000:

```
=== BEFORE cap (no limit) ===
Cache size: 1100 (unbounded on main)

=== WITH cap (PR branch) ===
Capped size: 1000
Entry #1099 preserved on main, dropped with cap: true

✅ Capping at 1000 prevents unbounded Map growth
```

Run with: `node --import tsx/esm -e "import { replaceGatewayModelPricingCache, ... } from './src/gateway/model-pricing-cache-state.ts'; ..."`

### Vitest

```
pnpm test src/gateway/model-pricing-cache.test.ts
  [...] "caps cache entries at MAX_PRICING_CACHE_ENTRIES" — passed
```

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/gateway/model-pricing-cache-state.ts` | +`MAX_PRICING_CACHE_ENTRIES` constant; `replaceGatewayModelPricingCache` caps incoming Map |
| `src/gateway/model-pricing-cache.test.ts` | +1 test: cache entry cap at 1000 |
